name: Timestamp
description: Convert between Unix timestamps and dates in seconds, milliseconds, microseconds or nanoseconds across time zones
help: The unit is detected from the number of digits (10 s, 13 ms, 16 μs, 19 ns) or can be chosen manually.
Shows local time, UTC and a comparison zone together with ISO 8601, RFC 2822, weekday, day of year and ISO week.
Dates accept RFC 3339, RFC 2822, bracketed zones and common forms such as 2024-02-29 12:00:00 or 2024/2/29; inputs without a zone use the selected zone.
Everything runs in local Rust with a bundled time zone database.
